map.由支出分项求 GDP 使用指南: GDP from Expenditure Components User Guide
map.输入消费 C、投资 I、政府支出 G 与净出口 NX，按支出法 Y=C+I+G+: Enter consumption C, investment I, government spending G and net exports NX, and compute GDP by the expenditure approach Y = C+I+G+(X-M), for macroeconomic accounting.
map.输入消费 C、投资 I、政府支出 G、净出口 NX，求 GDP。: Enter consumption C, investment I, government spending G and net exports NX to find GDP.
map.总量核算：录入四项，算 GDP 总量。: Total accounting: enter the four items to compute total GDP.
map.结构分析：看各项占比，判断需求驱动结构。: Structural analysis: look at the share of each item to judge the demand-driven structure.
map.教学演示：演示净出口为负（逆差）拉低 GDP。: Teaching demonstration: show that negative net exports (a deficit) drag GDP down.

map.房价算投资？: Does house price count as investment?
map.新建房算投资 I，二手房价不计入（仅是资产转移），房租算消费 C。结果仅作经济学: A newly built house counts as investment I, the price of a second-hand house does not (it is only an asset transfer), and rent counts as consumption C.
